item.text: I’ll inspect the test module and trace the expectations it encodes for any definite mistakes.

This module provides small shop-order helpers:

- Calculates item totals and discounts
- Computes an “average item price”
- Formats an order into line items plus a discounted total

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; the last iteration accesses `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`, causing a `TypeError`. It should use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides the full order total by the number of line items, so it returns the average line subtotal—not the average per-unit item price. It should divide by total quantity if “item” means unit.
- `averageItemPrice([])` would produce `NaN` (and currently `calcTotal([])` throws first). Empty orders need a defined handling policy.
- `formatOrder` also fails for any order because it calls the broken `calcTotal`.
